## Design

### 2026-10-07 — SO!! I MADE A VERY CUTE-SY Schematic today!!

**4h**

SO!! I MADE A VERY CUTE-SY Schematic today!!

Well it is cute and functional!

This will be my new and improved macropad, my forth design from scratch!

Features Of This Hackpad:-

+ 9 keys(not too many not too less)
+ 0.91" OLED
+ Backlighting with sk6812 mini-e
+ XIAO RP2060 based
